sources.title: BamiBERT: A New BERT-based Language Model for Vietnamese
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce BamiBERT—a new pre-trained language model for Vietnamese—trained from scratch on a large corpus of 129GB of uncompressed text for 20 epochs, with an extended maximum context length of 2048 tokens.

sources.snippet: From word segmentation to raw text: what BamiBERT changes BamiBERT is a BERT-based language model trained from scratch on 129GB of Vietnamese text that eliminates the need for external word segmentation—a requirement that has constrained Vietnamese NLP since PhoBERT's 2020 release.
